summary: Complete initial independent audit of all 216 Chinese source units, 71 temporal or active-hint checks, and 19 extracted people. Numbered Song reign years and the legendary allusions are supported where their source wording and event ownership match. Four source-specific chronology findings remain: two relative/undated formulations were converted too precisely, and the 1067 generic Grand Empress Dowager event is assigned to the wrong individual. No source or canonical extraction was edited.

findings.problem: The fourth-year source calls the subject 太皇太后 at Shenzong’s accession, but the extraction assigns it to a record defined as the Grand Empress Dowager under Zhezong. The two dated contexts concern distinct people.
